Woman and three children fall from fort tower in Maharashtra; three dead

A woman and her three children fell from an 80-foot-high tower at Naldurg Fort in Maharashtra. The woman and two of her children died from their injuries. The incident occurred at the fort, a historical site. Details regarding the circumstances of the fall were not specified in the coverage.
